sentences.text: Cameron M. Bready is chief executive officer and a member of the board of directors of Global Payments Inc.
(NYSE: GPN), an Atlanta-based provider of payment technology and software solutions.

sentences.quote: Most recently, he was president and chief operating officer for Global Payments, overseeing the company's worldwide merchant solutions businesses across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Latin America, along with worldwide operations, risk management, product and real estate. From 2014 to 2019, Cameron served as the company's senior executive vice president and chief financial officer.
sentences.text: He joined the company in 2014 as senior executive vice president and chief financial officer and served as president and chief operating officer from 2019, overseeing its worldwide merchant solutions businesses, global operations, risk management, product and real estate.
He succeeded Jeffrey S. Sloan as president and chief executive officer effective June 1, 2023.

Before Global Payments he was executive vice president and chief financial officer of ITC Holdings Corp., a publicly traded electric transmission utility, which he joined in 2009 after serving as vice president of finance at Northeast Utilities and, earlier, senior vice president at Mirant Corporation.

sentences.text: Cameron M. Bready became CEO of Global Payments in June 2023, having joined as CFO in 2014 and served as president and COO from 2019.

sentences.quote: About $600 million of annual run-rate cost synergies and at least $200 million of revenue synergies, targeted within roughly three years of completion.
sentences.text: Management closed the Worldpay acquisition and the Issuer Solutions sale ahead of schedule, repositioning the group as a pure-play commerce provider, with about $800 million of run-rate synergies targeted within roughly three years.
On capital allocation, the board authorized $2.5 billion of repurchases and over $2 billion of shareholder returns in 2026, alongside a roughly 3.0x net leverage target by end-2027.
Reception is mixed: BTIG downgraded the shares and Morgan Stanley faulted the restructuring presentation after an investor event.

sentences.text: Global PMTS Inc is the ticker-listing name for Global Payments Inc (NYSE: GPN), an Atlanta-based payment technology and software company serving merchants in person, online and mobile, and a member of the Fortune 500 and S&P 500.

Completion of the Worldpay acquisition and the sale of Issuer Solutions to FIS turned the company into a pure-play commerce solutions provider, roughly doubling scale, with about $1.2 billion of the Q1 2026 revenue increase coming from Worldpay.

sentences.quote: The company expects its broader transformation initiatives to generate more than $650 million of annual run-rate operating income benefit by the first half of 2027. In addition, Worldpay integration activities are targeted to deliver $600 million of annual run-rate expense synergies by year-end 2028.
sentences.text: Management targets over $650 million of annual run-rate operating income benefit from transformation by the first half of 2027, plus $600 million of Worldpay expense synergies by year-end 2028.
Guidance calls for 2026 normalized constant-currency adjusted net revenue growth of about 4-5% and adjusted EPS of $13.60-$13.80.
A $500 million accelerated buyback supports plans to return over $2 billion to shareholders in 2026.
